senses.gloss:
Oṅkāra_Bhaṭṭa
--Bhūgolasāra. jy. PUL. II. p. 229. R. A. Sastri I. p. 41. Sūcīpattra 18.

Oṅkāravāda
viś. adv. by Anantācārya (Anantālvān, 1822-62 A. D.) of Melkote in Mysore. See NCC. I. p. 143a.
Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 14. Oppert I. 171. 3112.
Pt.. in the collection Vedāntavādāvalī, Bangalore, 1898 an. in Śāstramuktāvalī Series, Conjeevaram.

Oṅkāravādārtha
vedānta. criticism of Mādhva view by Rāmasubrahmaṇya Śāstrin of Tiruviśanallūr in Tanjore District. Adyar D. X. 181. MT. 1808 (g). 1814 (h).

Oṅkāravādārtha
dvai. by Vidyādhīśatīrtha. See BNK. Sarma, His.. of Dvai. Lit. II. p. 272. Probably same a. that by Vijayīndratīrtha. See MT. 1432 (c).
--by Viśvādhīśa. Kṛṣṇapur 289.

Oṅkāravādārtha
also called praNavadarpaNa by Śrīnivāsācārya; different from his Nayamaṇikalikā which is also called Oṁkāravādārtha. MD. 4932-3. See also Praṇavadarpaṇa.

Oṅkāravādārtha
also called nayamaNikalikA viś. adv. criticism of the Mādhva view that the Praṇava is part of each of the Brahmasūtras. by Śrīnivāsācārya of Surapuram, son of Tātārya an. grandson of Aṇṇaya. See NCC. I under Aṇṇaya I.
Adyar II. p. 156b. Adyar D. X. 291. Amarcinta I. 11. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 14 (a. Veṅkaṭācārya, a mistake). MD. 4871. 4872 (inc.). 17264 (inc.). MT. 48. 1295. Mysore II. p. 23.
See also J. of the Andhra His. Res. Soc. XIII. i. p. 13. [Page094-b]

Oṅkāravicāra
also called praNavadarpaNakhaNDana dvai. a criticism of Praṇavadarpaṇa or Oṁkāravādārtha of Śrīnivāsācārya. by Vijayīndratīrtha, disciple of Vyāsatīrtha. Some mss. ascribe the work to Vidyādhīśa; but the introductory verse refers to Vyāsatīrtha a. guru.
MD. 479 (g). MT. 1432 (c) (a. called Vidyādhiśa). Mysore II. p. 25 (a. called Vidyādhīśa). N. S. Press 121 (Text called Oṁkāravāda).

Oṅkārasarvasva
being the Praṇavasūtra, a series of aphorisms in 7 khaṇḍas, ascribed to the Ṛṣi Kāśyapa.
Pt.. with a Hindi C., Benares, 1912. Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 771.

Oṅkārastotra
in 12 verses from Ādipurāṇa, Śivāgama. Lz. 438.

Oṅkārādipañcavarṇastava
stotra. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 14 (2 mss.).

Oṅkāreṇapratyagbrahmābhedapratipatti
with C. by Rāmānuja (Śrībhāṣyakāra ?). Allahabad 169 (with C.).

Oṅkāropaniṣad
same a. nAdanindUpaniSad (See Mu7nchen p. 109). Haug 44. Jodhpur 30. Mu7nchen 184 (p. 109). 185 (p. 119.)
See Nādabindūpaniṣad.
